cohort: The study included 202 women who self-identified as having experienced traumatic childbirth during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: The study found that traumatic childbirth experiences during the COVID-19 pandemic were positively related to posttraumatic growth, with a significant positive association observed between disruption of core beliefs and PTG.
mod_finding: Type of birth was related to perceived stress levels, and cesareans were highly associated with high levels of perceived stress.
cross-section timing: after traumatic childbirth during the COVID-19 pandemic
